title: Demonstrating the Efficacy of a Spanish-Language Program for Latino Dementia Caregivers
official: Demonstrating the Efficacy of "Unidos en el Cuidado" (United in Caring): A Spanish-Language Program for Latino Caregivers of Persons Living With Dementia
summary: The investigators will test the efficacy of Unidos en el Cuidado® (United in Caring, herein Unidos), a 3-session, culturally-adapted, group psychoeducational and skill-building intervention for 226 Spanish-speaking family caregivers in California.
conditions: Caregiver Burden of People With Dementia
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* identifies with being Hispanic or Latino descent
* speaks and reads Spanish
* dementia family caregivers living (or recently lived) in California or whose care recipient lives (or recently lived) in California
* who identify as women, men, or non-binary,
* age 18 years or older

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe sensory or physical conditions that interfere with ongoing participation.
